notes.system: Template-owned. Replaced wholesale by sidecar-update.yml on every upstream release.
notes.system_if_uninitialized: Template-owned only while the file still contains real {{TOKEN}} markers (the rail greps for specific setup tokens like {{ACCOUNT_ID}}, not a blanket '{{' — templates mention {{PLACEHOLDER}} in prose). Once setup fills it, the file is the user's and is never touched again — it is skipped and named in the update PR instead.
notes.user: Never touched by tooling. JOURNAL.md, DECISIONS.md and LOOP_PROMPT.md appear here and in system_if_uninitialized; the placeholder check is what resolves the overlap. A repo that predates DECISIONS.md simply doesn't have the file, so the rail delivers the seed template on the next update — the {{DATE}} tokens in it make the check read 'uninitialized' exactly once.
notes.workflow: .github/workflows/sidecar-update.yml cannot update itself (GITHUB_TOKEN may not push workflow-file changes). When the rail changes upstream, the update PR body flags it as a one-file manual copy.
